reason: Short seasonal self-naming captions are attested; the longer teaching bodies describe seasons in third person and also use instructional I/you. blockers.detail: No fixed naming/speech marker binds aiin or whole target blocks to seasonal speakers; caption voice cannot be silently extended to the complete poem.

all_of.detail: A separately declared whole-passage account supplies explicit speaker/addressee introductions, fixed indexical semantics and licensed speech transitions, without treating source captions as proof of prose narration.
